sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the mind. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and mental disturbances. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands and gout.
sections.Skin: Intense itching and burning. Eruptions like miliary rash. Eczema on the fingers and hands. Warts on the hands.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Gouty pains in the joints.
